title: JUL records still reach the logging backend after a test context resumes
summary: Checks context identity and counts JUL and direct SLF4J markers at the same Logback appender after each reuse.

subject.symbol: Spring TestContext cache → JUL and Logback appender

change.description: The Boot logging lifecycle opts out of pauses so reusing a cached context leaves its JUL-to-SLF4J bridge intact.

notes: The TestContext adapter uses the unchanged spring-boot-test main tree 40d684720ce0fde87e00849f58ec523058db2deb shared by both S37 pins and S34 parent. Both S37 runs use those same adapter bytes. The logging module itself comes from the respective S37 build.
